title: CRITICAL: Fix chunk deserialization failure
description:
Chunks are stored in RocksDB but fail to deserialize with 'io error: unexpected end of file'. This breaks search, semantic search, and embed commands.

Location: src/store.rs or src/chunk.rs
Root cause: Bincode deserialization failure

Reproduction:
1. mdsearch index test.md
2. mdsearch search 'test' -> No results

Acceptance:
- All chunks deserialize successfully
- search command returns results
- semantic and embed commands work
closeReason: Fixed bincode deserialization failure by adding #[serde(default)] to the embedding field in src/chunk.rs. All tests pass and deserialization verified working.

title: HIGH: Fix include/exclude filter flags
description:
The --include and --exclude flags for the index command don't filter files correctly. All files are indexed regardless of patterns specified.

Location: src/index.rs or src/main.rs

Reproduction:
1. mdsearch index . --include README.md
2. Expected: Only README.md indexed
3. Actual: All markdown files indexed

Acceptance:
- --include filters correctly
- --exclude filters correctly
- Both work with glob patterns
closeReason: Fixed include/exclude filter flags in index command. Implementation adds glob pattern compilation in Indexer::new and applies filters in discover_files() method. All tests pass, compilation successful, acceptance criteria met.

title: MEDIUM: Fix doctor --repair removing all documents
description:
The doctor --repair command removes ALL documents as 'empty' even when they have content.

Location: src/index.rs (run_doctor function)

Issue: All documents are incorrectly marked as empty and deleted during repair.

Acceptance:
- Only truly empty documents are removed
- Valid documents with content are preserved
closeReason: Fixed doctor --repair to only remove truly empty documents by checking file existence and content before removing

title: MEDIUM: Fix duplicate -f short flag conflict
description:
Both --format and --filter use the -f short flag in the search command.

Location: src/main.rs lines 75, 87

Issue: -f is ambiguous - could mean format or filter

Acceptance:
- Change --filter to use different short flag (e.g., -F)
- Update documentation
- Ensure no other short flag conflicts exist
closeReason: Fixed duplicate -f short flag conflict. Changed --filter from -f to -F in src/main.rs. Updated README.md documentation. Tests pass.
